title: Live the Nashville Dream: Write and Record Your Very Own Song!
blurb:
Ever curious what it's like to not only visit a music studio, but experience one? Whether you're a seasoned musician or you can't carry a tune in a pint glass, all are welcome! Come with an idea, poem, a hangover, your favorite instrument or just your favorite people! 

Sessions in my home studio in West Nashville will be 1-3 hours, during which we'll write a poem, find a melody and record a quick acoustic demo for you to take home as an mp3! All are welcome. Come experience the studio!
